review_notes: Read the whole file. Checked JZero's definition (abbrev for Pic0 over AlgebraicClosure ℚ, so the in-file lemma pic0_closure_eq_top applies by defeq) and confirmed sp_agreement already uses pic0_closure_eq_top. Compared the setup blocks of gal_equivariance and sp_agreement, and the two Equiv constructions in `solution`. Proposed lemmas are sketches that were not compiled. Typeclass and universe details of the generalized point-section lemma are the main uncertainty. I did not report the ptsA/ptsSp equivalence duplication in `solution` (lines 672-709) because I judged it too routine.

findings.problem: The `hclos` proof (decomposing a degree-zero divisor D as Σ D(v)•(single v − single w₀), then pushing through Pic0.mk and using closure membership) is a line-for-line copy of the already-proved general lemma `pic0_closure_eq_top` at lines 111-148. That lemma is stated for any algebraically closed K and `IsCurveOver K F`. sp_agreement already uses it (`rw [eq_top_iff, ← pic0_closure_eq_top w₀ Δ (fun v => rfl)]`), but gal_equivariance re-proves it inline, with `(AlgebraicClosure ℚ) (modularFunctionFieldBar p)` spelled out dozens of times. Both copies must be maintained and the 40-line duplicate buries the main argument.
findings.proposed_change: Delete lines 284-324 and replace them with `have hclos : AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range fun v => Pic0.mk (Δ v)) = ⊤ := pic0_closure_eq_top w₀ Δ (fun v => rfl)`. `JZero p` is an `abbrev` for `Pic0 (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) (modularFunctionFieldBar p)`, and `[IsCurveOver (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) (modularFunctionFieldBar p)]` and `IsAlgClosed (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)` are already in scope. The hypothesis `hΔ` holds by `rfl`, since `Δ v = ⟨_, hΔmem v⟩`, exactly as in sp_agreement. The `hdeg1` and `hΔmem` pieces that only fed the removed proof can stay, because `Δ` still needs `hΔmem`.
findings.benefit: Removes about 40 duplicated lines of nontrivial finsupp/sum reasoning. Both consumers then share one lemma, so fixes or API changes are made once, and gal_equivariance reads as its actual argument.

fun y => ⟨pullback.lift y.1 (𝟙 _) (by rw [y.2, Category.id_comp]) ≫ inv eη, by
      rw [Category.assoc, hinvη, pullback.lift_snd]⟩
findings.problem: The same fibre-point-transport machinery is written out three times. Lines 185-198 and 491-504 (plus `ofPlace` / `hplace_ofPlace` at 213-226 and 506-519) are copies for the geometric fibre. Lines 521-534 repeat it for the residue-field fibre, with `Ms`, `es`, `hes`, `inv es` and `(residue A).comp ρA` instead of `Mη`, `eη`, `heη`, `inv eη` and `algebraMap`. Each copy contains the same nontrivial reasoning: build the section `pullback.lift y.1 (𝟙 _) _ ≫ inv e`, check it is a point over the base via `IsIso.inv_comp_eq`, and prove `(toM y).1 ≫ e ≫ pullback.fst = y.1` (`htoM` / `htoM₀`) by `inv_hom_id_assoc` and `pullback.lift_fst_assoc`. The third copy additionally proves that `pointEquivPlace ∘ toM ∘ ofPlace = id` through `pullback.hom_ext`. The `hΔmem` / `Δ` / `hdeg1` definitions (238-246 and 540-547) are duplicated between the two theorems as well. The very long inline `Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ↥(GaloisRep.ratLocalizedAt ℓ) (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)))` terms make each copy hard to compare and hard to maintain.
findings.proposed_change: Add a general lemma in `GRAroadGlue`, for example: for `c : X ⟶ S`, `s : Spec k ⟶ S`, a `CurveModel k F` called `M`, `e : M.C ⟶ pullback c s` with `[IsIso e]` and `he : e ≫ pullback.snd c s = M.toBase`, define `toPoint e he : SchemeHomOver s c → {q // q ≫ M.toBase = 𝟙 _}`. Prove `toPoint_comp : (toPoint e he y).1 ≫ e ≫ pullback.fst c s = y.1` (the `htoM₀` statement, and `htoM` as its `≫ k` form), and `pointEquivPlace_toPoint_ofPoint : M.pointEquivPlace (toPoint e he (ofPoint e he x)) = M.pointEquivPlace x`. Here `ofPoint x := ⟨x.1 ≫ e ≫ pullback.fst c s, _⟩` is the current `ofPlace` before composing with `pointEquivPlace.symm`. Proof sketches: `IsIso.inv_comp_eq` for the base condition; `Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc, pullback.lift_fst_assoc` for the fst identity; `pullback.hom_ext` plus `Subtype.ext` and `congrArg (· ≫ inv e)` for the round trip. In both theorems, replace the three local copies by `toPoint eη heη`, `toPoint es hes` and the lemma, instantiated with `s := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ...))` and `s := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((residue ↥A).comp ρA))`. The `[IsIso e]` instance is already available in both statements. A second small lemma `degZero_single_sub_single` could cover `hΔmem` / `Δ`, using `[IsCurveOver K F]`, `[IsAlgClosed K]` and `w₀` as parameters.
findings.benefit: Cuts roughly 100 duplicated lines of non-trivial categorical reasoning to three short instantiations. The shared hypotheses (`he`, `[IsIso e]`) are stated once, so the two long theorems become readable. A change to how sections are transported then needs one edit instead of three or four.
